scope: Selected important October 2026 announcements/events, not a fresh verification or replacement of all existing Current Affairs answers.

baseline.sha256Scope: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of the complete ordered published question objects, including options, answers, explanations and repeat metadata.

verificationMethod: Direct primary-page reads plus independent news/institutional corroboration. Every MCQ records two named answer-supporting authorities, direct HTTPS URLs and access date. Article publication dates and actual event/announcement dates were distinguished. Paywalled previews only support claims visible in those previews; failed canonical URLs are not presented as reviewed references.
bankProtection: Append USR-Q0021 through USR-Q0030 after the entire 11932-question release. Keep all previous question objects/order unchanged. Explicit app migration accepts only the approved old signature and unchanged prefix. Existing session pools and queue counts/cycles are preserved; newly started sessions see the appended category tail. No importance or past-paper repetition is fabricated.
duplicateMethod: All-bank normalized-stem and ID comparison, plus keyword/entity and correct-answer searches followed by manual event/year/office/fact comparison. Related pairs test different propositions, not rewordings of the same answer. Comparison IDs below are actual nearby prior facts, not exact duplicate findings.
sourceCaveats: The Guterres visit headline duration differs from official completion coverage. No duration question is added; the award and NDMA briefing are independently supported by accessible PID releases and Dawn.
IMF staff agreement announced 7 October is not Executive Board approval or disbursement. EFF-only US$1 billion must not be confused with RSF US$210 million or combined financing.
IAEA and broadcaster coverage differ in completion-city wording. No city question is added; both support the agency, first mission and PNRA host.
Borrowers' Platform governing council is not its earlier working group; the described role is technical learning/cooperation, not collective debt bargaining.
Ahad Khan Cheema was named incoming chair for 2027 on 16 October 2026, not said to have begun the term.

Nobel event dates are October announcement dates, not December ceremony dates. Canonical NobelPrize.org 2026 pages returned access errors; directly accessible awarding institutions and corroborating sources are used instead.
